_meta.distinctness_rationale: Identical prompts would let prefix caching, not the scheduler, drive Arm A's scaling_efficiency. 4.3.1 does not require distinctness; it is chosen here.
_meta.provenance: SYNTHETIC. Generated by the script named above from a seeded PRNG over a fixed word pool. Not sampled from real traffic, not human written, not drawn from any dataset. Nothing downstream reads the prompt text -- W1 measures throughput only.
_meta.template_boundary_open: 4.3.1 does not say whether prompt_tokens = 512 is counted before or after the chat template wrapper. This corpus stores RAW prompt text; the harness applies the template. The receipt's 4.4.6 tokenization block must declare which side of that boundary the count was taken on.
_meta.token_count_note: target_prompt_tokens is a TARGET. No tokenizer ran in this generator. The 512 +/-8 of 4.3.1 is asserted by the harness against the model's own tokenizer at measurement time; if it fails, retune --body-words and regenerate.
